footprints.note: Microchip SPAK-3LD-PL-1 package outline and recommended land pattern (R1), datasheets/regulator/microchip/MIC37150-1-2-3-1.5A-Low-Voltage-Microcap-LDO-Regulators-DS20006491A.pdf p.13: heat-spreader land 8.45 +/-0.05 x 8.00 +/-0.05, lead lands 1.00 +/-0.05 x 1.2 +/-0.05 at 2.54 BSC, 1.57 MIN between tab land and lead lands; body B 7.87-8.13 mid 8.00 x A 9.27-9.52 mid 9.395 (9.40), H 10.41-10.67 mid 10.54. Judgement: tab land centred on the body (its 8.00 equals B; the lead foot, tip at -4.00 + H 10.54 = 6.54 with P 0.79-1.04 long, then lies inside the lead land 5.57-6.77, 5.57 = body edge 4.00 + 1.57 gap); lead land centre 4.00 + 1.57 + 0.6 = 6.17 from the body centre. Drawing turned 90 deg clockwise (leads left, tab right, pin 1 at the top; the drawing has tab up and pin 1 at the left, pinout view p.2 tab left pin 1 bottom). The tab is the unnumbered pad 0 (pinout 3 pins; tab = GND). Hand check 2026-11-21: placement changed. The outline's H (10.41-10.67, mid 10.54) runs from the tab tip to the lead tip and K (0.76-1.27, mid 1.015) is the tab protrusion beyond the body B 8.00, so tab tip at 5.015 and lead tip at 5.525 from the body centre on opposite sides (lead foot P 0.79-1.04 spans about 4.61-5.525); the land (8.00 tab land + 1.57 gap + 1.2 lead land = 10.77) is centred on that tip-to-tip extent like the other regulator power packages: tab land centre x +1.13, lead land centre x -5.04 (turned view, leads left). Was: tab land centred on the body (x 0) and lead lands at x -6.17, which put the lead feet (tip at 5.525) off the lead lands (5.57-6.77)
